findings.description: Possible race condition due to use of time.sleep for lock polling.
findings.code_snippet:
msg = "Lock %s not acquired on %s, waiting %s seconds ..."
_LOGGER.debug(msg, lock_id, lock_filename, poll_interval)
time.sleep(poll_interval)
findings.reasoning: The code uses time.sleep for polling in a lock acquisition loop. This approach can introduce race conditions and performance issues, especially if the poll_interval is not handled correctly or if there is contention. However, analysis of actual exploitability, performance impact, and missed atomicity would require further review of the implementation, poll interval settings, and lock usage across the codebase. Marked for manual review.
